sources.title: Nasus Build Guide: 🔸Nasus / Stack Now, Ascend Later🔸

passive.name: Soul Eater
passive.text: Nasus drains his foe's spiritual energy, giving him bonus Life Steal.

spells.name: Siphoning Strike
spells.text: Nasus strikes his foe, dealing damage and increasing the power of his future Siphoning Strikes if he slays his target.

spells.name: Wither
spells.text: Nasus ages an enemy champion, decelerating their Move Speed and Attack Speed over time.

spells.name: Spirit Fire
spells.text: Nasus unleashes a spirit flame at a location, dealing damage and reducing the Armor of enemies who stand on it.

spells.name: Fury of the Sands
spells.text: Nasus unleashes a mighty sandstorm that batters nearby enemies. While the storm rages, he gains increased Health, Attack Range, damages nearby enemies, has a reduced cooldown on Siphoning Strike, and gains bonus Armor and Magic Resistance.

damage.value: Nasus’s damage type is unspecified, but his sandstorm deals sustained damage to nearby enemies.

archetype.value: Nasus is a top-lane fighter and tank who farms patiently to become a late-game threat.

axis.value: Nasus plays lane by controlling the wave and stacking Siphoning Strike when it is safe.

winCondition.value: Nasus turns farmed stacks and map pressure into towers, objectives, forced rotations, or winnable fights.

spikes.why: Nasus becomes a greater threat as his Siphoning Strike stacks accumulate.
Nasus turns each stack into a stronger late-game threat.

spikes.at: As Nasus builds Siphoning Strike stacks
spikes.why: Nasus becomes a stronger late-game threat.

bait.why: Nasus loses access to his sandstorm’s offensive and defensive bonuses while Fury of the Sands is on cooldown.

mistakes.value: Nasus makes a mistake by stacking Q when the opportunity is not safe.
Nasus gives up safe farming opportunities when he tries to control the map before controlling the wave.
Nasus misses a chance to strengthen future Siphoning Strikes when he fails to slay a target with one.
